say:1:1536127001:1.text: Of course they do. The strong, once blessed, become even stronger!
say:1:1536127001:1.source_cn: 为什么不需要？只有强者接受恩赐，才会变成更强者！
say:1:1536127001:1.male: Of course they do. The strong, once blessed, become even stronger!
say:1:1536127001:1.female: Of course they do. The strong, once blessed, become even stronger!

say:2:1536127002:1.text: The weak? Even with the Hunting Goddess' blessing, they'll never amount to much.
say:2:1536127002:1.source_cn: 弱者即使接受狩猎神的恩赐，又能强到哪去？
say:2:1536127002:1.male: The weak? Even with the Hunting Goddess' blessing, they'll never amount to much.
say:2:1536127002:1.female: The weak? Even with the Hunting Goddess' blessing, they'll never amount to much.
